categories.main_business_segments: Giant Group primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of bicycles, indoor fitness bikes, electric bicycles (E-bikes), and related products. The company also engages in aluminum alloy parts and rims manufacturing, carbon fiber composite material R&D and application, sports goods manufacturing and sales, bicycle rental services, outdoor activity promotion, and investment in bicycle production and sales companies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced carbon fiber technology, including proprietary carbon fiber frame designs and manufacturing techniques such as the Advanced SL carbon fiber technology. It integrates innovative features like one-piece internal cable routing and develops electric control systems for E-bikes. Production emphasizes automation, smart manufacturing, and lean processes inspired by Toyota Production System (TPS), with global production bases enabling flexible and efficient supply chain management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Giant serves a diverse customer base including professional cyclists, recreational riders, commuters, and fitness enthusiasts. Key markets include Europe, North America, China, and Taiwan, with products tailored for competitive racing, leisure, urban commuting, and fitness. The company also targets female cyclists through its Liv brand and youth segments with specialized bicycles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global presence with production facilities and sales operations spanning Taiwan, China, Vietnam, Europe, North America, and other Asian markets. Major sales markets are Europe (33.5%), Asia (43.4%), North America (8.6%), and Taiwan (7.5%). It maintains extensive dealer networks and retail stores worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: Giant operates across the midstream and downstream segments of the bicycle supply chain, including R&D, manufacturing, assembly, branding, marketing, and after-sales service. It controls key components production such as frames and electric systems, while sourcing other parts from global suppliers. The company also provides OEM/ODM services for other brands.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on sustainable innovation, developing low-carbon and environmentally friendly materials, and advancing electric bicycle technologies with integrated smart control systems. R&D emphasizes high-performance competitive bicycles, lightweight carbon fiber frames, and user-centric design. The company also invests in digital transformation, enhancing consumer experience through e-commerce, customization platforms, and digital fitting systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of bicycles, E-bikes, bicycle components, and related gear under its own brands (Giant, Liv, Momentum, CADEX) and OEM/ODM manufacturing. Additional income comes from bicycle rental services and consulting/investment activities. The company also leverages sponsorships and brand partnerships to enhance market presence.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Giant is positioned as a global leader in the mid-to-high-end bicycle market, recognized as one of the top three brands in Europe and North America. It competes with other major international bicycle manufacturers by leveraging its comprehensive value chain, innovation capabilities, and strong brand portfolio. The company maintains a competitive edge through product differentiation, quality, and sustainability initiatives.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Giant Group reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$71.3 billion, a 7.4% decrease from the previous year, with net profit declining by 62.8% to NT$1.26 billion. Despite short-term fluctuations due to inventory adjustments and market demand shifts, the company maintains a strong financial base with total assets around NT$78.7 billion and equity of NT$36.7 billion. It continues to invest heavily in R&D and production capacity expansion to support long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Giant emphasizes delivering high-quality, innovative, and sustainable bicycle products that cater to diverse consumer needs, from professional racing to urban commuting and fitness. Its unique value lies in integrating advanced carbon fiber technology, smart electric assist systems, and comprehensive after-sales service including lifetime frame warranties. The company also leads in sustainability by pioneering low-carbon materials and promoting cycling culture globally.
